BL-786 — Stryker concurrency is three hand-tuned constants (8, 12, 12) that no host ever checks: BL-427 measured the number and built the recommender, but nothing calls it
What it solves: The lesson worth carrying into review, beyond the fix: BL-427 was an
explicitly measure-first slice that did everything right except file its own
follow-up. It measured, it built the recommender, it wrote the report, and
it said in that report that a follow-up must exist so the reading is not
froze…
Approval context: Filed medium deliberately, and the reasoning is worth a glance because the expedite lane is crowded and the human has twice asked to unblock the JumpQ batch.
The honest read is that this is real but contained: it degrades manually invoked, usually overnight mutation runs, not the swarm's steady sta…
BL-786 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-786" (or "reject BL-786 <reason>") to act.
